title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Joshua 4: the twelve memorial stones from the Jordan and the camp at Gilgal.

questions.text: How many stones were the men told to take from the middle of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says to take twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, where the priests' feet stood firm.

questions.text: How was each man to carry his stone?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says each of them was to pick up a stone and put it on his shoulder.

questions.text: What were the stones to be for the children of Israel forever?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever."

questions.text: Besides the stones carried to the camp, where did Joshua set up twelve stones?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, where the feet of the priests who bore the ark stood.

answers.text: In the middle of the Jordan, where the priests' feet stood
On the top of Mount Nebo, across from Jericho
At the gate of Jericho, beside the city wall
In the plains of Moab, by the river bank

questions.text: About how many men ready and armed for war passed over to the plains of Jericho?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says about forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh.

questions.text: How did Israel regard Joshua after Yahweh magnified him?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

answers.text: They feared him as they had feared Moses
They gave him a portion of land

questions.text: What happened when the priests' feet were lifted up to the dry ground?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and went over all its banks, as before.

answers.text: The waters returned to their place, as before
The river stayed dry for seven more days
A spring of water broke out at Gilgal
The walls of Jericho began to shake

questions.text: On which day did the people come up out of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month.

answers.text: The first day of the first month
The fourteenth day of the first month
The seventh day of the second month
The tenth day of the first month

questions.text: Where did Israel camp, and where did Joshua set up the twelve stones?
questions.explanation: They encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho, and Joshua set up the twelve stones in Gilgal.

questions.text: In verse 23, to what earlier event is the drying up of the Jordan compared?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says Yahweh dried up the Jordan as he did to the Red Sea, which he dried up before them.

answers.text: The flood in the days of Noah
The drying up of the Red Sea
The crossing of the river Arnon
